title: Capitals of Central Africa
short: Match each Central African country with its capital, such as Kinshasa (DR Congo) and Luanda (Angola).
trouble: Students swap Kinshasa and Brazzaville, which face each other across the Congo River.

practice.q: Which capital lies across the Congo River from Kinshasa?
steps: Kinshasa is on the south bank, in the DR Congo.
On the north bank is Brazzaville, capital of the Republic of the Congo.
practice.title: Across the river

blocks.html: Here are the capitals of the nine countries of Central Africa. Two of them face each other across a river.

head: Country
Capital
rows: Ciudad de la Paz (see the note)
blocks.cap: Countries and capitals of Central Africa.

blocks.html: Kinshasa (DR Congo), Brazzaville (Republic of the Congo), Luanda (Angola), Yaoundé (Cameroon), N'Djamena (Chad), Bangui (Central African Republic), Libreville (Gabon) and São Tomé. Equatorial Guinea has a note: in 2026 it named Ciudad de la Paz, a new city on the mainland, as its capital in place of Malabo, on Bioko Island, which still holds much of the government. Both are accepted here.

Kinshasa and Brazzaville grew where the Congo River widens into a lake-like stretch called the Pool Malebo, just above a long series of rapids. Boats coming down the river had to stop there, so towns grew on both banks. Today each is the capital of a different country, and only the river separates them.

blocks.q: Which capital lies across the Congo River from Kinshasa?

On the north bank is Brazzaville, capital of the Republic of the Congo.

blocks.title: Cameroon's capital
blocks.q: Douala is Cameroon's biggest port. What is the capital?

blocks.html: People swap Kinshasa and Brazzaville. Link the big city to the big country: Kinshasa is the capital of the large Democratic Republic of the Congo; Brazzaville is the capital of the smaller Republic of the Congo.
